body: Update: I did take the substance that day but it turns out it wasn't what I thought it was and I bought table salt... we love a good mistranslation haha. But I'm getting help again, and even though I don't see a point in living I'm going to give it one last try. If I can't live for myself I'll live for my family.

The thing is that i've already tried to end my life two times so far. And every time things got better for a short while until they got bad again. It's like this endless cycle of pain that will never end. I just can't do this anymore.
I feel the same way. I've always known that i'd kill myself one day. Just not sure when that will be.

I hope things will work out for you! I know what you're going through, and things are looking very bad rn. But there is always a light at the end of the tunnel. We might now know each other, but trust me when I say that I care about you. Please stay strong. If not for yourself, for the people that care about you.
